_comment: Stories read by hand in Youssef's Chrome from the Saudi Press Agency search (spa.gov.sa/search?q=<body name>&exact_search=1&by_latest=1, Arabic query, page 1 = 10 newest), because SPA refuses the automated collector with a Cloudflare wall (since 8 Nov 2026). fetch_gov_news.py merges every capture within the retention window; a story is kept only when the body is named in its headline (same rule as the automated SPA search). Add a new capture object each Sunday; never edit a past one. `n` is the SPA story number (https://spa.gov.sa/N<n>).
